summary: One independently testable behavior: the MacGuffin is placed in final-zone world data with a retrieval interaction rule and >=2 foreshadow trace links; retrieval triggers an observable sim state change (environment, creature flag, or return-journey path). Three changed subsystems: simulation rules (interaction + post-retrieval state change), world content data (object placement, trace references, visual properties), headless scenario tests (fresh-save reach-retrieve-assert). Evidence is focused on a single scenario with determinism and negative-case checks. Handoff names specific artifacts (WI-01c by id, WI-04b trace ids, ST-03 species) and respects spoiler rules. Dependencies on WI-04b/WI-04a are covered by the parent story's depends_on ST-04.
